# Unused plugin manifests (kept only for license/provenance completeness)

These files were the plugin registration manifests of Microsoft's `powerbi-authoring` plugin. They have been renamed and moved here so that **no tool (VS Code, Copilot CLI, Claude Code) auto-discovers them**:
- `.mcp.json`, which registers the Modeling MCP via `npx -y …@latest` and would download at startup
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `.github/plugin/plugin.json`

The PBI Agent Kit does **not** install this plugin. It uses the plugin's Markdown references as read-only documentation only (see `../../APPLICABILITY.md`). The kit's own MCP configuration is generated by `pbi mcp-config`.
